name: Approved native monster stat-block mechanics
description: Captures approved rules not yet represented by executable rewrite systems. These mechanics apply through the same native rules used by characters; no monster-specific edition engine.

savingThrows.policy: All nine are independent saving throws with independently modifiable bonuses. Fortitude/Reflex/Will do not alias, replace, or automatically grant proficiency in corresponding ability saving throws.
savingThrows.attackRoll: Ability modifier + applicable proficiency + other modifiers, with explicit creature-defined exceptions.
savingThrows.monsterProficiency: Keep the existing 5.x CR-based proficiency scale for the initial bestiary; no new BAB engine.

hitPoints.hitDieSize: Inherited creature-type default, overridable by creature definition.
hitPoints.hitDieCount: Creature-specific; used for HP, source-compatible abilities, and other explicit rules, not a required leveling track.
hitPoints.constitution: Constitution modifier contributes per Hit Die under the ordinary HP formula; additional explicit rules may modify it.
hitPoints.existingStatblocks: Do not change previously reconciled HP formulas or CR automatically.
hitPoints.monsterAdvancement: Optional future stat-block customization; not required for bestiary testing.

percentage.name: Unified Resistance/Vulnerability
percentage.storage: Sparse by damage type: omit 0 entries; absent values resolve to 0.
percentage.immunity: The +100% endpoint is displayed and treated as Immunity.
percentage.rounding: Final fractional-damage rounding remains to be specified.

damageReduction.method: Flat subtraction applicable to any damage type unless a specific grant says otherwise.
damageReduction.grants: Each DR grant has a nonnegative flat value and optional arbitrarily expressible bypass condition; no codified bypass vocabulary.
damageReduction.stacking: Sum all applicable, non-bypassed DR values.
damageReduction.order: Apply signed percentage damage modification first, then subtract applicable flat DR.

magicalResistance.name: Magical Resistance
magicalResistance.selection: Choose method based on what the creature ability narratively represents, not automatically by historical source edition.
magicalResistance.penetration: Qualifying magical effects must overcome a resistance value before taking effect; penetration scaling deferred to native spellcasting reconciliation.
magicalResistance.savingThrowAdvantage: Advantage on qualifying magical saving throws; does not add an independent penetration check.
magicalResistance.merging: Historical 3.x Spell Resistance and 5.x Magic Resistance do not automatically stack as two separate grants.
magicalResistance.exceptions: Use existing feature language and effect rules for unusual applicability or bypass.

abilityClassifications.presentation: Full names preferred; stat-block placement and formatting deferred.

summary.Supernatural: Magical capability that is not a spell
summary.Spell-Like: Magical capability behaving similarly to a spell, without necessarily being spellcasting

abilityClassifications.mechanicalDefaults: Fine-grained dispel, counterspell, magical penetration, and action-timing interactions remain subject to individual feature rules and magic-system reconciliation; no automatic conversion of all Spell-Like abilities into spells.

automaticHealing.foundation: Recover specified HP at the defined interval, ordinarily start of turn; never above maximum.
automaticHealing.policy: The name Regeneration does not implicitly grant all historical 3.x nonlethal-damage and survival consequences.

attacks.naturalWeapons: Distinct attack capabilities using the shared attack framework; natural weapons can have their own damage, reach, and effects.
attacks.multiattack: Explicitly authorized sequences may use natural and manufactured attacks together.
attacks.fullAttack: No separate universal 3.x Full Attack action.
attacks.legacySequences: Do not automatically stack historical Full Attack and modern Multiattack suites.

feats.policy: Preserve feat identity and explicit creature grants for later character-system feat reconciliation.
feats.runtime: Feat prerequisites, progression, and mechanical effects deferred.
feats.acquisition: No automatic monster HD-based feat progression for initial bestiary.

nonGoals: Rebalancing existing monsters during data migration
